title: Explainer Skill
scriptSegments: This video was generated by Claude. On your laptop. For free.
I built an open source skill. You give the agent a topic — it does four things.
One. It writes a custom narration script.
Two. It writes a fresh H-T-M-L animation page. A new design for every topic. No fixed templates.
Three. Microsoft Edge T-T-S generates the voiceover. No A-P-I key. No account.
Four. A headless browser records the animation. F-F-mpeg muxes the audio in. You get a finished M-P-4.
The whole pipeline runs on your machine. No subscription. No watermark. No limit.
Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor — any A-I agent that runs code.
